ns2:section.sectionText: Human Rights in a Global Context The course will not only introduce students to substantive topics within human rights but will provide an opportunity to further develop critical thinking, oral presentation, research, and writing skills. Lastly, the course is designed to encourage discussion and to raise many more questions than it will answer. The goal is to provide students with some of the necessary tools to investigate, research and think critically about human rights as a critical component of our global society.
